title: GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism
description: GPipe splits a model into sequential micro-stages across devices and streams micro-batches through the pipeline, keeping all devices active simultaneously. Enables training models that don't fit on a single accelerator. The re-materialization strategy (recompute activations in backward pass) reduces memory by factor proportional to pipeline depth.
authors: Huang, Cheng, Bapna, Firat, Chen, Chen, Lee, Ngiam, Le, Wu, Chen (Google Brain)
